gates.safety_gate: Fuel-cell string start interlocks and fire or gas detection coordination recorded.
gates.notes: Pack-local evidence captures concrete fuel-cell permissive and detection-loop facts until a reusable fuel-cell catalog exists.

gates.safety_gate: Phase-sync tolerances documented and met with machine Evidence.
gates.notes: Phase, frequency, and voltage machine Evidence support the synchronization gate.

gates.safety_gate: Controlled island transition drill passed under the approved EOP.
gates.notes: The ledger should reference this SAT event for the black-start or islanding window, including transfer sequence telemetry.

gates.safety_gate: UPS and ride-through expectations are explicit in the machine definition.
gates.notes: Records measured ride-through duration against the machine-definition requirement before the island drill is accepted.

gates.safety_gate: Resync and return sequence completed with fail-closed behavior if Evidence is missing.
gates.notes: Return-to-grid Evidence should be captured before handoff export; missing sync or return evidence blocks the transition.
